name: Ready, Set, Date!
source:
You've been chatting online for some time, and now you finally have the chance to meet your date face-to-face! Depending on your choices (and your date's personality), will your date succeed or fail miserably? Ready, Set, Date! <3

[From [url=https://eggnoodl23.itch.io/ready-set-date-alpha]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你们已经在网上聊了好一阵子，如今你终于迎来了与约会对象线下面对面奔现的机会！根据你的选项（以及约会对象的性格特征），这场约会究竟会圆满成功，还是惨淡收场？各就各位，预备，约会开始！<3

[摘自[url=https://eggnoodl23.itch.io/ready-set-date-alpha]itch.io[/url]]
